answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil coalitions by binding each identity to bonded collateral and shared behavioral evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), preventing cheap parallelization. Upon detection, the controlling escrow suffers an exponential multiplier in capital loss, making larger swarms economically fatal. An echo across an onyx grove may be harmless; correlated votes are not.
